How to Submit Public Comment:
Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of the following
methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card, indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the City Clerk
prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3) minutes per person per item. At the Chair’ s
discretion, the time limit may be shortened to allow all speakers to address the Community Services
Commission.

Website: Electronic submission of Public Comment is available via the City’s website as noted below. Public
Comment submitted electronically by 4:00 P.M. on the meeting day will be forwarded to the Commission
before the meeting for their consideration but will not be read during the meeting. Comments submitted
after 4:00 P.M. will be forwarded to Commission but may not be received before the meeting.

Website: Please submit your comments using the online public comment form at Public Comment.

   MINUTES OF JULY 6, 2026
 REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

CALL TO ORDER

Vice Chair Xing called the regular meeting of the Community Services Commission to order at
6:38 P.M. on Monday, July 6, 2026, with Commissioners and staff in the Council Chamber at City
Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Duong.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present:  Nancy Duong, Mayra Plascencia, Yi "Ethan" Xing

Commissioners Absent:  Davis Barrantes, Darwin Rodriguez

ANNOUNCEMENTS
Assistant Director Morales-Stevens provided information for the public on how to submit
comments and how to request meeting agendas. If you wish to address the Community Services
Commission, email all public comments to CSCommission@sangabriel.gov.

1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

The agenda was approved.

2. PUBLIC COMMENT
  None.

3. ACTION ITEMS

COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  JULY 6, 2026
   A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A motion was made by Commissioner Duong and seconded by Commissioner
  Plascencia to approve the minutes of the Community Services Commission Meeting
  for June 1, 2026.

  Motion approved as presented by a vote of 3-0-0-2 as follows:

  AYES:  DUONG, PLASCENCIA, XING
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  BARRANTES, RODRIGUEZ

4. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  A. EVENTS AND PROGRAMS UPDATES
  Presented by Assistant Director Morales-Stevens

  The Commissions asked about the pricing for the after school program and what the
  discount would be for lower income participants. They asked if this is only available
  to San Gabriel city residents.

  The Commission encourages residents to bring their bikes for the Walk, Bike & Roll
  Day event, especially since parking is limited at Marshall Park. The Commission asked
  if we could potentially collaborate with METRO and they will also reach out to local
  bicycle shops for this event.

  Commissioners shared that they’ve heard concerns from seniors who are worried
  about renovations at Smith Park Pool because they like to socialize at the park and
  they’re worried about temporary closures.

  B. WORKPLAN DISCUSSION
  Presented by Assistant Director Morales – Stevens

  There was a small edit made to the workplan. Commissioners suggested adding an
  item for the Mission Playhouse Centennial to assist with fundraising or garnering
  interest. This item will also be discussed at the August meeting.

  They want to discuss strategies to connect with TAWA and other huge shopping
  centers to use that space to advertise upcoming programs and services.
  The Commission asked if it was possible to dedicate a Ride SG van to transport
  residents to Marshall Park for the bike event.

5. COMMISSIONER REPORTS

COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  JULY 6, 2026
   Commissioner Duong attended the Independence Day Celebration & Drone show.

  Commissioner Plascencia is looking forward to the bike event and attending the Smith Park
  community outreach meetings.

  Vice Chair Xing asked if we can also incorporate using REDNOTE for the Mission Playhouse
  Centennial and to engage with youth.

6. STAFF COMMENTS
  Presented by Assistant Director Morales-Stevens

  None

7. ADJOURNMENT
  Chair Rodriguez adjourned the meeting at 7:26 p.m.
  The next regular meeting held on Monday, August 3, 2026, in the Council Chamber at City
  Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776, at 6:30 pm.

Adrienne Franquez, Commission Clerk

  STAFF REPORT
DATE:  August 3, 2026

TO:  Community Services Commission

FROM:  Matthew Morales-Stevens, Community Services Assistant Director

SUBJECT:  Mission Playhouse Centennial Update

The Mission Playhouse was established in 1927 and staff are working on marketing and
events in support of the centennial celebration throughout 2027.

Staff are currently working with We the Creative to develop a centennial logo and brand
guide.

To honor the 100th anniversary of the Mission Playhouse, the City of San Gabriel invites
you to step behind the lens and tell its story. From architectural beauty to community
moments, show us what makes this historic landmark truly magical.

Enter the photo contest artists are asked to submit the following:
  • Submit up to 10 photos featuring the Mission Playhouse
  • Shot on your phone or a professional camera—everyone is welcome

Photos will be judged on creativity, quality, and connection to community.

The Mission Playhouse will be open to the public on Thursday, Sept 17 from 4pm to 8 pm
and Saturday, September 19 from 11am to 3pm. This is the time set aside for the public
to take photos of the interior for submission. Participants will be required to sign a waiver
before entering.

Submission portal opens September 8, 2026 and closes October 30 at 5pm. A winner will
be selected for each of the following categories: interior of the playhouse, exterior of the
playhouse, and community choice. The top ten photos will be displayed at the Centennial
events throughout 2027.

Below are the tentative events/ programs:

  •  Museum Walk- March 2027
  •  Silent Sundays- enhanced showings
 •  June 2027- Playhouse Aglow event
•  September 2027- Playhouse Non-profit Launch and Visioning Event
   City of San Gabriel
  MEMORANDUM
DATE:  August 3, 2026

TO:  Community Services Commission

FROM:  Matthew Morales-Stevens, Community Services Assistant Director

SUBJECT:  Community Services Commission Workplan

PURPOSE OF THE COMMISSION
The purpose of the Community Services Commission is to creatively and inclusively
explore ways in which the Community Services Department can enrich quality of life for
residents of the City of San Gabriel by providing equitable access to dynamic programs,
services and spaces that strengthen community connection and engagement.

SCOPE OF THE COMMISSION
The Community Services Commission serves as an advisory body to the Community
Services Department and City Council, and functions as a liaison between residents and
city government. It is the responsibility of the Community Services Commission to
advocate on behalf of the San Gabriel community and to ensure that the Community
Services Department’s programs, services, spaces and events advance the Commission’s
purpose.

Purpose of the Workplan
The Annual Workplan is intended to guide the work of the Community Services
Commission and outline the areas of focus for 2024. It includes proposed programs and
projects that will be implemented and completed throughout the year.

Current Workplan
The workplan sets four priority areas as identified in the Community Services
Strategic Plan for the Community Services Department. The following list of ideas,
programs and activities are not intended to be exhaustive or to limit the action items the
Commission can explore. The list below reflects amendments made at the July and
October Regular Community Services Commission Meetings.

  1. Create New Innovative Programs and Services to Engage the Entire
  Community
  a. Appoint two youth ambassadors for the 26/27 school year
